map.常见哈希算法输出长度速查计算器。: Look up the output length (bytes and bits) of common hash algorithms (MD5, SHA family) for hash value storage planning.
map.用于预估哈希值存储空间。: Used to estimate hash value storage space.
map.字段设计：为数据库/索引选择哈希长度以平衡冲突与存储。: Field design: choose hash length for databases/indexes to balance collision and storage.

map.仅用于非安全校验（如去重），因其已被攻破不可用于完整性/防篡改。: Only for non-security checks (e.g. dedup); broken, so not for integrity/tamper resistance.
map.位数与安全性关系？: How do bits relate to security?
map.抗碰撞强度约与位数半相关（生日攻击），SHA-256 远强于 MD5/SHA-1: Collision resistance scales roughly with half the bits (birthday attack); SHA-256 far exceeds MD5/SHA-1.
map.为何同时给字节与位数？: Why give both bytes and bits?
map.存储按字节、展示常用十六进制（2 字符/字节），两者都常用。: Storage uses bytes, display uses hex (2 chars/byte); both are common.
